verses.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.pt: Não admitirás falso rumor. Não serás cúmplice com o ímpio para ser falsa testemunha.
verses.en_web: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
verses.en_bbe: Do not let a false statement go further; do not make an agreement with evil-doers to be a false witness.

verses.en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verses.pt: Não seguirás aos muitos para mal fazer; nem responderás em litigio inclinando-te à maioria para fazer injustiças;
verses.en_web: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be moved to do wrong by the general opinion, or give the support of your words to a wrong decision:

verses.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.pt: nem ao pobre privilegiarás em sua causa.
verses.en_web: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
verses.en_bbe: But, on the other hand, do not be turned from what is right in order to give support to a poor man's cause.

verses.en: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.pt: Se encontrares o boi de teu inimigo ou seu asno extraviado, traze-o de volta.
verses.en_web: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
verses.en_bbe: If you come across the ox or the ass of one who is no friend to you wandering from its way, you are to take it back to him.

verses.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
verses.pt: Se vires o asno do que te aborrece caído debaixo de sua carga, lhe deixarás então desamparado? Sem falta ajudarás com ele a levantá-lo.
verses.en_web: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him, you shall surely help him with it.
verses.en_bbe: If you see the ass of one who has no love for you bent down to the earth under the weight which is put on it, you are to come to its help, even against your desire.

verses.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.pt: Não perverterás o direito de teu pobre em seu pleito.
verses.en_web: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
verses.en_bbe: Let no wrong decisions be given in the poor man's cause.

verses.en: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.pt: De palavra de mentira te afastarás, e não matarás ao inocente e justo; porque eu não justificarei ao ímpio.
verses.en_web: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: Keep yourselves far from any false business; never let the upright or him who has done no wrong be put to death: for I will make the evil-doer responsible for his sin.

verses.en: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.pt: Não receberás suborno; porque o suborno cega aos que veem, e perverte as palavras justas.
verses.en_web: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: Take no rewards in a cause: for rewards make blind those who have eyes to see, and make the decisions of the upright false.

verses.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: E não angustiarás ao estrangeiro: pois vós sabeis como se acha a alma do estrangeiro, já que estrangeiros fostes na terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be hard on the man from a strange country who is living among you; for you have had experience of the feelings of one who is far from the land of his birth, because you yourselves were living in Egypt, in a strange land.

verses.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.pt: Seis anos semearás tua terra, e recolherás sua colheita:
verses.en_web: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
verses.en_bbe: For six years put seed into your fields and get in the increase;

verses.en: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
verses.pt: Mas no sétimo a deixarás vazia e liberarás, para que comam os pobres de teu povo; e do que restar comerão os animais do campo; assim farás de tua vinha e de teu olival.
verses.en_web: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
verses.en_bbe: But in the seventh year let the land have a rest and be unplanted; so that the poor may have food from it: and let the beasts of the field take the rest. Do the same with your vine-gardens and your olive-trees.

verses.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.pt: Seis dias farás teus negócios, e ao sétimo dia folgarás, a fim que descanse teu boi e teu asno, e tome refrigério o filho de tua serva, e o estrangeiro.
verses.en_web: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
verses.en_bbe: For six days do your work, and on the seventh day keep the Sabbath; so that your ox and your ass may have rest, together with the son of your servant and the man from a strange land living among you.

verses.en: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.pt: E em tudo o que vos disse sereis avisados. E nome de outros deuses não mencionareis, nem se ouvirá de vossa boca.
verses.en_web: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Take note of all these things which I have said to you, and let not the names of other gods come into your minds or from your lips.

verses.en: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.pt: Três vezes no ano me celebrareis festa.
verses.en_web: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
verses.en_bbe: Three times in the year you are to keep a feast to me.

verses.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.pt: A festa dos pães ázimos guardarás: Sete dias comerás os pães sem levedura, como eu te mandei, no tempo do mês de Abibe; porque nele saíste do Egito: e ninguém comparecerá vazio diante de mim:
verses.en_web: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
verses.en_bbe: You are to keep the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days let your bread be without leaven, as I gave you orders, at the regular time in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt); and let no one come before me without an offering:

verses.en: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.pt: Também a festa da colheita, os primeiros frutos de teus trabalhos que houveres semeado no campo; e a festa da colheita à saída do ano, quando haverás recolhido teus trabalhos do campo.
verses.en_web: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
verses.en_bbe: And the feast of the grain-cutting, the first-fruits of your planted fields: and the feast at the start of the year, when you have got in all the fruit from your fields.

verses.en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: Três vezes no ano comparecerá todo homem teu diante do Senhor DEUS.
verses.en_web: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Three times in the year let all your males come before the Lord God.

verses.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.pt: Não oferecerás com pão levedado o sangue de meu sacrifício, nem a gordura de meu animal sacrificado ficará da noite até a manhã.
verses.en_web: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give the blood of my offering with leavened bread; and do not let the fat of my feast be kept all night till the morning.

verses.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
verses.pt: As primícias dos primeiros frutos de tua terra trarás à casa do SENHOR teu Deus. Não cozerás o cabrito com o leite de sua mãe.
verses.en_web: The first of the first fruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.en_bbe: The best of the first-fruits of your land are to be taken into the house of the Lord your God. The young goat is not to be cooked in its mother's milk.

verses.en: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.pt: Eis que eu envio o anjo diante de ti para que te guarde no caminho, e te introduza no lugar que eu preparei.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am sending an angel before you, to keep you on your way and to be your guide into the place which I have made ready for you.

verses.en: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.pt: Guarda-te diante dele, e ouve sua voz; não lhe sejas rebelde; porque ele não perdoará vossa rebelião: porque meu nome está nele.
verses.en_web: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
verses.en_bbe: Give attention to him and give ear to his voice; do not go against him; for your wrongdoing will not be overlooked by him, because my name is in him.

verses.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.pt: Porém se em verdade ouvires sua voz, e fizeres tudo o que eu te disser, serei inimigo a teus inimigos, e afligirei aos que te afligirem.
verses.en_web: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: But if you truly give ear to his voice, and do whatever I say, then I will be against those who are against you, fighting those who are fighting you.

verses.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.pt: Porque meu anjo irá adiante de ti, e te introduzirá aos amorreus, e aos heteus, e aos perizeus, e aos cananeus, e aos heveus, e aos jebuseus, aos quais eu farei destruir.
verses.en_web: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
verses.en_bbe: And my angel will go before you, guiding you into the land of the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, and they will be cut off by my hand.

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.pt: Não te inclinarás a seus deuses, nem os servirás, nem farás como eles fazem; antes os destruirás por completo, e quebrarás inteiramente suas estátuas.
verses.en_web: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
verses.en_bbe: Do not go down on your faces and give worship to their gods, or do as they do; but overcome them completely, and let their pillars be broken down.

verses.en: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.pt: Mas ao SENHOR vosso Deus servireis, e ele abençoará teu pão e tuas águas; e eu tirarei toda enfermidade do meio de ti.
verses.en_web: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
verses.en_bbe: And give worship to the Lord your God, who will send his blessing on your bread and on your water; and I will take all disease away from among you.

verses.en: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.pt: Não haverá mulher que aborte, nem estéril em tua terra; e eu cumprirei o número de teus dias.
verses.en_web: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.en_bbe: All your animals will give birth without loss, not one will be without young in all your land; I will give you a full measure of life.

verses.en: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.pt: Eu enviarei meu terror diante de ti, e abaterei a todo povo onde tu entrares, e te darei o pescoço de todos os teus inimigos.
verses.en_web: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
verses.en_bbe: I will send my fear before you, putting to flight all the people to whom you come; all those who are against you will go in flight, turning their backs before you.

verses.en: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.pt: Eu enviarei a vespa diante de ti, que lance fora aos heveus, e aos cananeus, e aos heteus, de diante de ti:
verses.en_web: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
verses.en_bbe: I will send hornets before you, driving out the Hivite and the Canaanite and the Hittite before your face.

verses.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.pt: Não os expulsarei de diante de ti em ano, para que não fique a terra deserta, e se aumentem contra ti as feras do campo.
verses.en_web: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
verses.en_bbe: I will not send them all out in one year, for fear that their land may become waste, and the beasts of the field be increased overmuch against you.

verses.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.pt: Pouco a pouco os expulsarei de diante de ti, até que te multipliques e tomes a terra por herança.
verses.en_web: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
verses.en_bbe: Little by little I will send them away before you, till your numbers are increased and you take up your heritage in the land.

verses.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.pt: E eu porei teu termo desde o mar Vermelho até o mar de filístia, e desde o deserto até o rio: porque porei em vossas mãos os moradores da terra, e tu os expulsarás de diante de ti.
verses.en_web: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
verses.en_bbe: I will let the limits of your land be from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the waste land to the river Euphrates: for I will give the people of those lands into your power; and you will send them out before you.

verses.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.pt: Não farás aliança com eles, nem com seus deuses.
verses.en_web: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.en_bbe: Make no agreement with them or with their gods.

verses.en: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.pt: Em tua terra não habitarão, não seja que te façam pecar contra mim servindo a seus deuses: porque te será de tropeço.
verses.en_web: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
verses.en_bbe: Let them not go on living in your land, or they will make you do evil against me: for if you give worship to their gods, it will certainly be a cause of sin to you.
